title: High-stakes Michigan Democratic primary pits progressive against moderates
summary: It's a fight between two Democrats over who will be the party's choice to try and win Michigan's Senate seat in November. But it is also bigger than that. contentText: It's a fight between two Democrats over who will be the party's choice to try and win Michigan's Senate seat in November. But it is also bigger than that. The primary pits progressives against moderates – and is seen as a moment of reckoning for the Democratic Party on how to proceed in swing states for the 2028 Presidential election. Details by FRANCE 24 correspondent in Washington, Fraser Jackson.
